versions.changelog:
Initial release of RequestHunt skill — generate user demand research reports from real user feedback.

- Collects and analyzes feature requests, complaints, and questions from Reddit, X, GitHub, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Amazon.
- Includes detailed installation and authentication instructions for the CLI tool.
- Provides platform selection guidance and recommended strategies for common product categories.
- Outlines end-to-end research workflow: scoping, data collection, and report generation.
- Advises on content safety, ensuring safe handling of user-generated content.
- Lists CLI usage examples and report templates to streamline research.
